g.text: image pushtalk-api (apps/api, target api; ffmpeg included)
(depends_on): postgres and redis healthy → migrate finishes → api, worker, transcriber, flower → api healthy → web
uploads and processed Opus files, shared by api, worker and transcriber (read only).
starts as a copy of the image's base model; other sizes are downloaded here on first use.
adds: postgres :5433 and redis :6380 on localhost, api :8001 with uvicorn --reload,
worker and transcriber restarted on code change (watchfiles); `pnpm dev` (:5173) proxies to the api.
